2151. Checking Whether Three Sides Form a Valid Triangle

50

Medium

Problem Statement
Read three side lengths and determine whether they can form a triangle, using a function that returns 1 or 0.

Description
Three side lengths can form a triangle only if the sum of any two sides is greater than the third side. Read three positive integers a, b and c from input. Write a function isValidTriangle that takes three integer parameters and returns 1 if they form a valid triangle, otherwise 0. In main(), print "Valid" or "Not Valid" based on the returned value.
input_spec:
. Write a function isValidTriangle that takes three integer parameters and returns 1 if they form a valid triangle, otherwise 0. In main(), print "Valid" or "Not Valid" based on the returned value.

Input Description
Three positive integers a, b and c separated by spaces.
output_spec: Print "Valid" if the sides form a triangle, otherwise print "Not Valid".
